card.name: Separators and breaks inside label text
card.fires_on: Punctuation, separators and bullet or slash marks that sit between items in drug-label text, such as a slash between two names, a bullet before an instruction, or a broken character in a table cell.

modes.label: Slash between paired names
modes.description: A slash joining two class numbers or two product names.
modes.example: New York Heart Association Class III<< />> IV heart failure

modes.label: Table or bullet breaks
modes.description: A garbled character or bullet that starts the action part of a dosing table or list.
modes.example: Any CTCAE Grade 3 or 4 adverse reaction �<<�>> Decrease dosage by 25%

modes.label: Citation and name joints
modes.description: Small pieces inside citations or compound names, such as al or a colon after a volume number.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese news words and odd fragments, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on separator marks and joints between items in label text, such as slashes, bullets and citation bits.
